name: fpesa
description: Fpesa — live FX & gold trading platform for Kenya

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client-admin install
scripts._comment_build: --include=dev is required: hosts set NODE_ENV=production for the build, which makes npm skip devDependencies — and the TypeScript compiler, Vite and the React type packages all live there.
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client-admin install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client-admin run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
